request.candidates_and_roles: No candidates exist. Working, best-known, and retained model roles are all empty.
request.cumulative_resource_use: Startup session S1 completed without training or measurement operations; no candidate, evaluation panel, or other campaign resource has been produced.
request.current_goal_gap: There is no trained candidate or behavioral evidence yet, so the campaign does not know the attainable success level or whether the dominant obstacle is reaching, settling, active hold regulation, inverse-kinematic branch choice, or target geometry near joint-limit and conditioning extremes.
request.current_synthesis: The pre-campaign physical model supports a coupled-control interpretation: bounded torque at 50 Hz must first move the damped two-joint system to a valid inverse-kinematic posture and then actively cancel residual joint motion so the endpoint remains inside a 1 cm tolerance for 100 consecutive checks. The hold requirement is the most stringent part of the goal because damping alone does not guarantee endpoint regulation, and branch posture and target geometry can change dynamic authority and boundary margin. These are mechanistic expectations, not campaign evidence.
request.decision_frontier: In goal review, choose one bounded inquiry that most reduces uncertainty about the route to 98% success. The key decision is whether to begin with behavioral failure decomposition of a baseline learned policy across target geometry and hold dynamics, or whether an implementation-level obstacle is already sufficiently evident to justify changing the policy, reward, observations, or training distribution first.
request.human_goal_connection: The human goal requires at least 196 of 200 official episodes to complete an uninterrupted 2-second hold. The initial scientific direction therefore prioritizes understanding and improving the full reach-to-stabilized-hold behavior, rather than optimizing approach reward or endpoint reach in isolation.
request.next_direction_or_closure: Open a goal-linked inquiry focused on identifying the dominant failure mechanism for complete-hold success. The first evidence-producing action should establish a reproducible baseline and quantify reach, first entry, longest hold, interruptions, residual motion, branch/posture, and target-geometry dependence; use that evidence to select any subsequent scientific intervention.
